title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Vannathi is startled to see Pallavan at the cinema with Aravind. She panics on spotting Pandian too and struggles to avoid them, while Nila waits alone at home for Chozhan.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Bagyaraj forces Suresh to apologise to Malar's mother and Karthi. Malar demands a maid while Mathi offers to pay, convincing everyone despite Ragavan's furious objection.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Tamizhselvi and Aishwarya arrive at court with audio evidence, hoping to prove Sethupathi's innocence. However, the judge dismisses it as insufficient to support their claim.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Aadhavan and Arjun aid Karthik financially, moving Kasthuri. Meanwhile, Aadhavan hides Pooja's photo from Karikalan and sneaks into her room to meet her.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Vennila fumes at Rajeshwari for pressuring her to settle her mother's debt. Anbu and Karthi get rebuked by a doctor for opting for C-sections to spare their wives labour pain.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Shanmugam and Abhi plead with Indhira to conceal their marriage plans from his family. Indhira struggles to hide the truth from Murugan, who suspects she is concealing something.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Meena defends Senthil against Gomathi and Pandian's angry outburst over his drinking. Meena leaves silently as Pandian furiously bans Gomathi from telling Senthil anything.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Enraged by the fertility test conducted on Ravi, Muthu confronts Vasudevan. With Shruthi highlighting Ravi's lack of consent, Vasudevan is compelled to apologise to him.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Vetri comforts Sandhya's mother over her distress about her daughter's disinterest in marriage. Later, he encourages Shanmugam to turn his stitching work into a business.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Poongodi warns Azhagar against drinking and confronts Deivanai. Sudalai dreams of his victim, while Thenmozhi covers for Mayandi's secret coffee swap with Meenatchi.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Paraman faces public criticism over his rowdy past during his campaign. Ilamathi takes him to a salon for a makeover, surprising his friends with his transformed appearance.
